items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: Because, you know, Fats, he could really play.

ctx.x: Yes. Fats Waller used to play there.

Yeah. Yeah. And that's where I heard -- at the Lincoln Theater -- or was it the Lafayette? Either the Lincoln or the Lafayette, Fats was playing organ, and Fats used to play -- Fats was playing the organ, then the pit band came on. Then they played together, the organ and the pit band, and that was one of the most beautiful sounds I'd ever heard up till then. I never heard a band and an organ play together. And, oh, that was beautiful, beautiful, you know. Because, you know, Fats, he could really play. He --…
That was probably at the Lincoln, then, where he used to play the organ.
